sections.title: GM19 Clearance And Interference Grid
sections.text: Extends assembly.interference/assembly.clearance to declared body pairs or all pairs from instances; include/exclude filter pair ids, expectedContacts carry a cause/range and are retained. Joint rotation/slide ranges are sampled as a Cartesian product, not a synchronous diagonal. budget.maxChecks guards pair x sample count. broadPhase may prune AABBs only when no joints are sampled and minimum is zero; those unsafe combinations are rejected before sampling. Joint ranges temporarily drive real joints, so clearance.grid is mutating and readOnly:false.

sections.title: Return Contract And Restoration
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, plan, results[], minimumConfig, worstCaseGap, coverage {tested,skipped,failed,unknown,total,continuousVerified:false}, poseRestored and restoreErrors. Joint sampling saves the actual exposed baseline values, restores each in finally and verifies joint.inspect readback; setter success alone is not proof. Unsigned distance is not penetration depth; Boolean failure is not an empty intersection. If execution fails or restoration is uncertain, inspect the document before retrying; no save/rollback or continuous-sweep proof is provided.

sections.title: GM19 Motion Envelope
sections.text: Computes a motion envelope for a moving body over a translation or rotation range. representation sampled returns the union AABB over samples; conservative returns a bounded envelope (exact straight-translation AABB sweep, or a bounding-sphere torus for rotation); certified requires an explicit certifiedPath coverage proof, without which continuousVerified stays false. Dense grids and sums of sampled bodies do not prove continuous no-collision.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, representation, continuousVerified, envelopes, sampledEnvelope, sampleCount, conservativeEnvelope, errorBound, axis, range, and (for certified) certifiedPath. Lengths cm, angles rad.
